entry.en: Your passport must be valid for the duration of your stay in Armenia.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe ser válido durante toda tu estancia en Armenia.
entry.quote: your passport must be valid for the duration of your stay.

entry.en: You will be denied entry without a valid travel document or with a passport reported lost or stolen.
entry.es: Se te denegará la entrada sin un documento de viaje válido o con un pasaporte denunciado como perdido o robado.
entry.quote: You will be denied entry if you do not have a valid travel document or try to use a passport that has been reported lost or stolen.

entry.en: Citizens of Azerbaijan must have a special entry permit to visit Armenia.
entry.es: Los ciudadanos de Azerbaiyán necesitan un permiso de entrada especial para visitar Armenia.
entry.quote: Citizens of Azerbaijan must have a special entry permit to visit Armenia.

entry.en: As of 2022, not all land border crossings allow visa on arrival, and the text advises getting the e-visa in advance if in doubt.
entry.es: En 2022 no todos los pasos fronterizos terrestres permitían visado a la llegada; el texto aconseja sacar el e-visado antes si hay dudas.
entry.quote: As of 2022, not all land border crossings allow for visa on arrival.

safety.en: The border with Azerbaijan remains closed, and FCDO advises against all travel within 5km of the entire eastern border.
safety.es: La frontera con Azerbaiyán sigue cerrada y el FCDO desaconseja todo viaje a menos de 5 km de toda la frontera oriental.
safety.quote: The border with Azerbaijan remains closed. FCDO advises against all travel to within 5km of the entire eastern border between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

safety.en: FCDO advises against all travel along the M16/H26 road between Ijevan and Noyemberyan.
safety.es: El FCDO desaconseja todo viaje por la carretera M16/H26 entre Ijevan y Noyemberyan.
safety.quote: FCDO advises against all travel along the M16/H26 road between the towns of Ijevan and Noyemberyan.

safety.en: The land border with Turkey is closed, although there are scheduled direct flights between Yerevan and Istanbul.
safety.es: La frontera terrestre con Turquía está cerrada, aunque hay vuelos directos programados entre Ereván y Estambul.
safety.quote: The land border with Turkey is closed, although there are scheduled direct flights between Yerevan and Istanbul.

safety.en: Crime levels are low, with occasional pickpocketing, bag-snatching, theft from cars and burglary involving foreign nationals.
safety.es: La delincuencia es baja, con incidentes ocasionales de carterismo, robo de bolsos, robos en coches y allanamientos que afectan a extranjeros.
safety.quote: Crime levels are low. There are occasional incidents of pickpocketing, bag-snatching, theft from cars and burglary involving foreign nationals.

safety.en: If you hail taxis on the street you risk being scammed for high fares.
safety.es: Si paras taxis en la calle corres el riesgo de que te estafen con tarifas altas.
safety.quote: If you hail taxis on the street you risk being scammed for high fares.

safety.en: It is illegal to photograph military bases, equipment and installations, and visitors have been detained for trying.
safety.es: Es ilegal fotografiar bases, equipos e instalaciones militares y hay visitantes detenidos por intentarlo.
safety.quote: It is illegal to photograph sites such as military bases, equipment and installations.

health.en: Public healthcare outside Yerevan is likely to be basic, while private hospitals are of a good standard but can be expensive.
health.es: La sanidad pública fuera de Ereván probablemente sea básica; los hospitales privados son buenos pero pueden ser caros.
health.quote: Public healthcare outside Yerevan is likely to be basic. Private hospitals in Armenia are of a good standard but can be expensive.

health.en: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Armenia, including Mount Aragats and the lakes of Aragats.
health.es: El mal de altura es un riesgo en partes de Armenia, incluidos el monte Aragats y sus lagos.
health.quote: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Armenia, including Mount Aragats (4,090m elevation) and the lakes of Aragats (approximately 3,000m).

health.en: For an ambulance, call 911 and ask for an English speaker.
health.es: Para una ambulancia, llama al 911 y pide un hablante de inglés.
health.quote: Call 911 and ask for an ambulance with an English speaker.

health.en: Tap water is generally safe, as it comes directly from mountains.
health.es: El agua del grifo suele ser segura, pues viene directamente de las montañas.
health.quote: The tap water is generally safe, as it comes directly from mountains.

help.en: The emergency number in Armenia is 911.
help.es: El número de emergencias en Armenia es el 911.

getting_in.en: Zvartnots International Airport, 10 km west of Yerevan, is the main airport in the country.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto internacional Zvartnots, a 10 km al oeste de Ereván, es el principal del país.
getting_in.quote: Zvartnots International Airport (EVN IATA) [1], 10 km west of Yerevan is the main airport in the country.

getting_in.en: e-Visas are processed online in up to two business days and allow entry through Yerevan Airport and some land crossings.
getting_in.es: Los e-visados se tramitan en línea en hasta dos días hábiles y permiten entrar por el aeropuerto de Ereván y algunos pasos terrestres.
getting_in.quote: These e-Visas are processed completely online and take up to two business days to be issued.

getting_in.en: At land crossings, border guards may take other currencies only at poor rates, so bring Armenian dram.
getting_in.es: En los pasos terrestres, los guardias pueden aceptar otras divisas solo a malos tipos, así que lleva drams armenios.
getting_in.quote: Try to have Armenian dram before arriving at the border.

getting_around.en: Public transportation is very good and inexpensive, about 100 dram per 10 km.
getting_around.es: El transporte público es muy bueno y barato, unos 100 drams por 10 km.
getting_around.quote: Public transportation is very good and inexpensive (about 100 dram/10 km) in Armenia

getting_around.en: Many Armenian marshrutkas do not sell or issue tickets beforehand.
getting_around.es: Muchas marshrutkas armenias no venden ni emiten billetes por adelantado.
getting_around.quote: many Armenian marshrutkas do not sell tickets beforehand, and do not issue tickets at all.

getting_around.en: Most trains are Soviet-era stock; the other trains are slow but incredibly cheap.
getting_around.es: La mayoría de los trenes son de la era soviética; los demás son lentos pero baratísimos.
getting_around.quote: Most trains in Armenia are Soviet-era stock.

getting_around.en: The Yerevan-Gyumri train with new rolling stock runs Friday to Sunday.
getting_around.es: El tren Ereván-Gyumri con material nuevo circula de viernes a domingo.
getting_around.quote: Two lines have new faster trains: the international Yerevan-Tbilisi (+Batumi in the summer), and the Yerevan-Gyumri line that runs Friday-Saturday-Sunday.

money.en: The dram is the only legal currency for commerce in Armenia.
money.es: El dram es la única moneda legal para el comercio en Armenia.
money.quote: the dram is the only legal currency for commerce.

money.en: Credit cards are not widely accepted outside Yerevan.
money.es: Las tarjetas de crédito no se aceptan ampliamente fuera de Ereván.
money.quote: Credit cards are not widely accepted outside Yerevan.

money.en: ATMs are widely available in larger towns; outside Yerevan you should have a Visa or MasterCard.
money.es: Los cajeros están ampliamente disponibles en ciudades grandes; fuera de Ereván conviene tener Visa o MasterCard.
money.quote: ATMs (Bankomats) are widely available in larger towns; though outside of Yerevan, you should have a major system such as Visa or MasterCard on your card for it to work.

money.en: Bargaining is uncommon in stores but a must in markets.
money.es: Regatear es poco común en tiendas pero imprescindible en los mercados.
money.quote: Bargaining is uncommon in Armenian stores, though when purchasing expensive items or bulk, they may be amenable to it. In markets, however, bargaining is a must!

money.en: Many restaurants charge a 10% service fee that is often not clearly stated on the menu.
money.es: Muchos restaurantes cobran un 10% de servicio que a menudo no figura claramente en el menú.
money.quote: Many restaurants have begun to charge a 10% “service fee” which they usually do not share with the waiters

etiquette.en: In churches, dress modestly; men remove hats and women cover their hair with a shawl or veil.
etiquette.es: En las iglesias hay que vestir con modestia; los hombres se quitan el sombrero y las mujeres cubren el cabello con un pañuelo.
etiquette.quote: When visiting churches, you are expected to dress modestly (i.e. no shorts, miniskirts, sleeveless shirts/tops), men are required to remove their hats, while women are required to cover hair with a shawl or veil.

etiquette.en: Staring is quite common in Armenia and indicates curiosity, not hostility.
etiquette.es: Es bastante común que te miren fijamente en Armenia, y indica curiosidad, no hostilidad.
etiquette.quote: Staring does not indicate hostility; it indicates curiosity.

etiquette.en: Direct personal questions about your life, salary or education are commonly asked and not considered impolite.
etiquette.es: Es habitual que hagan preguntas personales directas sobre tu vida, sueldo o estudios, y no se consideran descorteses.
etiquette.quote: Direct personal questions (based on your personal life, salary, education, and lifestyle) are commonly asked.

etiquette.en: On buses and trains you are expected to give up your seat to someone much older than you.
etiquette.es: En autobuses y trenes se espera que cedas el asiento a alguien mucho mayor.
etiquette.quote: on buses and trains, you are expected to give up your seat to someone much older than you.

connectivity.en: A temporary prepaid SIM card is strongly advised, as they are cheap and convenient.
connectivity.es: Se recomienda mucho una SIM prepago temporal, porque son baratas y cómodas.
connectivity.quote: It is strongly advised to acquire a temporary prepaid SIM card as they are cheap and convenient

connectivity.en: VivaCell MTS has booths offering free SIM cards to incoming visitors at the airport.
connectivity.es: VivaCell MTS tiene puestos que ofrecen SIM gratis a los visitantes en el aeropuerto.
connectivity.quote: VivaCell MTS has booths offering free SIM-Cards to incoming visitors at the airport.

connectivity.en: Yerevan is full of cafes with free wifi.
connectivity.es: Ereván está llena de cafés con wifi gratis.
connectivity.quote: Yerevan is full of cafes with free wifi.
